description: COP map model for ground-coupled heat pump — stable ground temperature gives better COP than ASHP

unit.name: Generic Ground-Coupled Heat Pump (Closed Loop)
unit.source: Staffell et al. (2012). Energy Environ. Sci., 5, 9291-9306. ASHRAE (2011). Geothermal Heating and Cooling Applications.

carnot_fraction.note: GHP Carnot fraction 0.50-0.60; higher than ASHP (0.40-0.50) due to stable ground source

T_ground_nominal.note: Mean annual ground temperature (stable year-round, 10-15°C typical)

ground_loop_offset.note: Ground loop fluid temperature offset from undisturbed ground T (heating: T_src = T_ground - offset)

T_source.note: Ground loop fluid temperature (stable, narrow range vs ASHP)
